ModMetaData.name: Concord Stale Wrapper Probe
ModMetaData.author: cryptiklemur
ModMetaData.description: In-game probe for the stale-method handler: a Concord patch on a RimWorld method keeps running after a mod injects a field onto that method's type. Field injection is a Waylith runtime feature, so 1.7 only. Not for workshop distribution.
